html:
Release plan

Select any text and right-click to leave a comment. Comments are stored in this file as HTML comments.

We should ship on Friday regardless of the QA timeline, because the release window closes Monday.

Here is a second paragraph with another highlighted span placed close to the first.

And a third point that is already resolved.

Code

def process(order):
    validate(order)

This body has no anchor any more.

Example syntax in a fence is ignored:

<!--c:ex01-->example span<!--/c:ex01-->
<!--co:ex01 status:open
me: not a real comment
-->

Diagrams

Mermaid fences render as diagrams. Hover one for Comment / Source; click it to zoom.

Flowchart

flowchart LR
  subgraph Browser
    A[Reviewer] -->|selects text| B(Annotator UI)
  end
  subgraph Daemon
    C{Valid comment?} -->|yes| D[Write markers into the file]
    C -->|no| E[Show an error]
  end
  B -->|WebSocket intent| C
  D -->|Doc update| B
  classDef ok fill:#dcfce7,stroke:#15803d
  class D ok

Sequence diagram

sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor R as Reviewer
  participant UI as Browser UI
  participant D as Daemon
  participant F as File
  R->>UI: Select text, add comment
  UI->>D: add_comment
  activate D
  D->>F: Insert markers
  Note right of F: Comments live in the Markdown file
  D-->>UI: Doc (html + comments)
  deactivate D
  UI-->>R: Highlight and sidebar card

Class diagram

classDiagram
  class Session {
    +String id
    +int round
    +open_round()
    +finish(done)
  }
  class DocState {
    +String html
    +CommentView[] comments
  }
  class CommentView {
    +String id
    +String status
    +String block_sourcepos
  }
  Session --> DocState : builds
  DocState "1" *-- "many" CommentView

State diagram

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Active
  Active --> Closed : Done
  Closed --> Active : Agent starts next round
  Active --> Abandoned : Abandon
  Abandoned --> [*]
  state Active {
    [*] --> Reviewing
    Reviewing --> Editing : switch to Source
    Editing --> Reviewing : autosave
  }

ER diagram

erDiagram
  SESSION ||--o{ ROUND : has
  ROUND ||--o{ THREAD : contains
  THREAD ||--|{ ENTRY : holds
  THREAD {
    string id PK
    string status
    string quote
  }
  ENTRY {
    string author
    string text
  }

Pie chart

pie showData title Review comments by kind
  "Anchored text" : 24
  "Code blocks" : 9
  "Orphaned" : 3
  "Replies" : 17
